It is a significant event, as it is one of the 4 tournaments that make up the Korn Ferry Tour Finals, which determine which players earn PGA TOUR cards for the following season.

programme.title: The HotelPlanner Tour Series 2026 - Rosa Challenge Tour
programme.desc: The Challenge Series features the key events on the European Challenge Tour. In keeping with the profile of the Tour’s players, the programming has a more youth orientated and dynamic look and feel to the typical golf shows. The content provides close up profiles with the future stars, life-style features, as well as all the exciting final day action from the event.

programme.title: DP World Tour 2026 - Amgen Irish Open Day 3
programme.desc: The Irish Open is a professional golf tournament on the European Tour. The Irish Open was first played in 1927. It's one of the biggest events on the European golf calendar and is known for showcasing top-tier golf at iconic Irish venues.

programme.title: Originals: Being Mario Götze

Hans-Joachim Watzke nennt den Schritt im Nachhinein eine "komplett falsche Entscheidung". Der Zeitpunkt der Bekanntmachung des Wechsels ist mehr als unglücklich. Mario Götze selbst ist sich sicher, wer diese Breaking News im April 2013 orc
